page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.t6-c1m4.large is a burstable instance type belonging to the ecs.t6 family. It features 2 vCPUs derived from a single physical core with hyper-threading enabled, running on an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor clocked at 2.5 GHz. The instance is equipped with 8.0 GB of system memory, providing 4.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, and operates on a KVM hypervisor.

Performance benchmarks indicate that this instance is positioned at the lower end of the spectrum. In stress-ng testing, single-core performance scored 1161.28, while multi-core performance reached 2371.48, placing it in the bottom tier. Memory bandwidth tests show a read-only small block cached speed of 187.49 GB/sec, which drops significantly to 22.38 GB/sec for uncached large blocks. Geekbench results align with these findings, yielding a single-core score of 1092.0 and a multi-core score of 1822.0.

Due to its burstable CPU allocation and lack of local storage, this instance is designed for low-intensity, intermittent workloads. It is qualitatively cost-efficient for development environments, lightweight testing, or basic web serving where continuous high CPU utilization is not required. It is not suitable for demanding database operations, large-scale LLM inference, or heavy multi-threaded processing.
